title: Stick-on cable clip
prompt: Stick-on cable clip for a 6 mm cable. It's a C-shaped ring (6 mm inside, 1.5 mm wall) with a 4 mm wide gap at the top to push the cable in, sitting on a flat foot 20 mm long and 2 mm thick that I'll put double-sided tape on. The ring's centre is 6 mm above the bottom of the foot, so the ring merges into the foot. The whole clip is 8 mm wide.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
20 mm long foot, 8 mm wide, 9–10.6 mm tall (depends on how the gap is cut)
The cable seat is a 6 mm diameter arc
The outside of the ring is a 9 mm diameter arc (1.5 mm wall)
Volume ≈ 526 mm³ ±8% (the lip faces may be radial or vertical)

notes: Reference cuts the gap with radial lip faces (inner corners at x = ±2). Volume 525.9 = 65.74 mm² profile (numerically integrated) × 8; vertical lip faces change it by < 5%.
